decisions.reason: The accelerator stays on the home page and costs little to run, so with the firm growing and having slack it can keep carrying this peripheral program, though its distance from the core makes it a likely target if results fall short of aspirations.

The bio-based bitumen binder is a flagship with its own page in both years, so management will tolerate its uncertain early results while growth and slack last and will not yet start problemistic search.

The infectious waste plant sits close to the core recycling machinery, is built with a partner, and is featured as a flagship on the home page with a concrete market launch, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no reason for dropping.
